name: voomate
description: Voice-first AI agent platform for websites — multi-tenant SaaS

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @voomate/i18n && npm run build -w @voomate/core && npm run build -w @voomate/db
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @voomate/api && npm run build -w @voomate/widget && npm run build -w @voomate/dashboard && npm run build -w @voomate/landing
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:verify: npm run verify:rls --workspace @voomate/db && npm run verify:retrieval --workspace @voomate/db
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
